phase4_performance.md.assumption: The N=8 scaling ratio (1.086×/quote) extrapolates toward N=100
phase4_performance.md.why: No cached multi-symbol data beyond 8 symbols
phase4_performance.md.falsifier: A replay at N=25 and N=50; the 1.96× `_on_horizon_tick` row is the one to watch

phase4_performance.md.assumption: A thread-CPU-time clock would separate compute cost from OS preemption in the tick timer
phase4_performance.md.falsifier: Measure both clocks side by side on the same replay

phase4_performance.md.assumption: The 20 unread event fields are genuinely unread and not reached via serialization
phase4_performance.md.falsifier: Per-field removal against the parity oracle

phase4_performance.md.assumption: Event construction cost (1,241.6 ns for `NBBOQuote`) is a live-path cost, not just a replay setup cost
phase4_performance.md.why: In backtest, events are constructed before the replay loop and excluded from the 136.2 µs; in live they are constructed per message inside it
phase4_performance.md.falsifier: Measure the live/paper ingestion path, which this harness does not cover

phase4_performance.md.assumption: The 22.6 µs/quote marginal cost per sensor is representative of sensors not in the measured set — the 13 registered differ in internal cost
phase4_performance.md.why: Measured as an average over 9 added sensors, not per sensor individually
phase4_performance.md.falsifier: Per-sensor probes at full registration; `--mode sensorscale` already installs the arming hook needed

phase4_performance.md.assumption: Sensor registration remains output-neutral for alphas other than `sig_benign_midcap_v1`
phase4_performance.md.why: Verified for one alpha (identical parity hash and fills across both legs). An alpha reading a feature whose warm-up depends on registration order could differ
phase4_performance.md.falsifier: Run `--mode sensorscale` against a second alpha once one exists

phase5_gaps.md.assumption: IB rejects a re-submitted duplicate `order_id` server-side, bounding G03's blast radius
phase5_gaps.md.why: Requires a live IB Gateway session and a deliberate duplicate submission; `paper_rth` tests never run in CI
phase5_gaps.md.falsifier: Submit a known-duplicate ID against paper IB and record the rejection

phase5_gaps.md.assumption: The 3 order-insensitive set-iteration sites in G08 remain order-insensitive
phase5_gaps.md.why: Verified by reading the loop bodies today; nothing enforces it
phase5_gaps.md.falsifier: A test that iterates each site's container in reverse and asserts an identical parity hash

phase5_gaps.md.assumption: G20 has never fired in any recorded run
phase5_gaps.md.why: The handler logs nothing, so absence of evidence is not evidence of absence
phase5_gaps.md.falsifier: Add a counter to the handler and replay the corpus — but that is a `src/` change, forbidden this phase

phase5_gaps.md.assumption: The 106 uncalled public methods in G44 are genuinely dead rather than reached by tests, CLI entry points or `getattr`
phase5_gaps.md.why: Static analysis covers `src/` call sites only
phase5_gaps.md.falsifier: Cross-reference against `tests/` and `scripts/`, then delete against the parity oracle

phase5_gaps.md.assumption: Phase 4's 136.2 µs/quote is representative of the live path
phase5_gaps.md.why: Backtest constructs events before the replay loop; live constructs them per message inside it (A4.4)
phase5_gaps.md.falsifier: Instrument the live/paper ingestion path, which no current harness covers

phase5_gaps.md.assumption: G41's 4.2× overrun would be worse at A>1 in proportion to alpha count
phase5_gaps.md.why: Measured with A=1; the engine-4 budget row is sized for growth but not measured under it
phase5_gaps.md.falsifier: A replay with two SIGNAL alphas registered
